title: Warranties as contractual undertakings
summary: A warranty concerns an undertaking about a characteristic, quality, or condition of goods or performance, with legal consequences if the undertaking is unfulfilled.
notes: Bayliner examines whether particular statements created an express warranty concerning the boat purchased. Northrop concerns competing warranty periods in exchanged forms. Express and implied warranties, their inclusion, and their exclusion raise distinct questions. The full separate casebook chapter on warranties is outside the assigned reading ranges in this syllabus.
